name: Hana Park
bio:
Hana Park's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a childhood fascination with the intricate workings of machinery. Initially training as a mechanical engineer, she quickly gravitated towards the high-stakes, high-precision world of racing. Her meticulous attention to detail and unwavering dedication to perfection caught the eye of several racing teams, ultimately leading her to Iron Lynx. 

Hana approaches fabrication with a unique blend of traditional craftsmanship and cutting-edge technology. She believes in a hands-on approach, personally overseeing every stage of the fabrication process to ensure the highest standards of quality. Known for her innovative problem-solving skills and ability to adapt to challenging situations, Hana is a valuable asset to the team, consistently pushing the boundaries of what's possible in motorsport engineering. Her reputation as a reliable and forward-thinking fabricator precedes her, making her a sought-after talent in the paddock.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly bobbed with subtle layers
physical.description: Hana is of average height with a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn engineering handbook.
Sharpens her pencils to an almost impossibly fine point.
Hums classical music while working on complex projects.
